concerns.text: The plan cites a **synthetic placeholder** for the Last.fm listening-history dataset because “No verified open source URL” is available. This violates FR‑001 (linked dataset must contain real BFI‑2 scores **and** Last.fm histories for the same participants) and the constitution’s Verified Accuracy principle. Using synthetic data cannot answer the research question about real user preferences, so the dataset choice is inappropriate for the intended analysis.
